sections.html:
virtually

(adverb). hầu như, gần như

Ex: Virtually all students will be exempt from the tax.

vanish

(verb). Biến mất

Ex: Much of the land we loved has vanished forever.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

territory

(noun). lãnh thổ

Ex: They have refused to allow UN troops to be stationed in their territory.

suppress

(verb). cầm lại, nén

Ex: The medication effectively suppressed the pain.

spearhead

(verb). dẫn đầu, xung kích

Ex: He is spearheading a campaign for a new stadium in the town.

short-sighted

(adjective). thiển cận

Ex: It's very short-sighted of the government not to invest in technological research.

shelter

(verb). che chở

Ex:The American government has accused them of sheltering terrorists.

rival

(verb). sánh với, cạnh tranh với

Ex: You will find scenery to rival anything you can see in the Alps.

reverse

(verb). đảo ngược lại

Ex: The government has failed to reverse the economic decline.

resurgence

(noun). sự trỗi dậy

Ex: The creation of independent states has led to a resurgence of nationalism.

outright

(adjective). hoàn toàn

Ex: She was the outright winner.

oppose

(verb). đối lập, chống đối

Ex: Do you support or oppose this proposal?

oblivion

(noun). sự bị lãng quên

Ex: An unexpected victory saved him from political oblivion.

intensity

(noun). cường độ, độ dữ dội

Ex: The explosion was of such intensity that it was heard five miles away.

habitat

(noun). Môi trường sống

Ex: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.

former

(adjective). đã từng là

Ex: The luxury apartments are in a former factory.

flourish

(verb). Hưng thịnh, phát triển

Ex: The arts began to flourish at that time.

estimate

(verb). Ước lượng

Ex: The satellite will cost an estimated £400 million.

enthusiast

(noun). người say mê, người hăng hái

Ex: She was an enthusiast for early Italian art.

endangered

(adjective). Có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng

Ex: The sea turtle is an endangered species .

dwindle

(verb). thu nhỏ lại, giảm

Ex: Support for the party has dwindled away to nothing

dense

(adjective). Dày đặc

Ex: The forest is quite dense at that point.

demise

(noun). Cái chết

Ex: Smoking was the cause of his early demise.

decline

(verb). sụt giảm

critically

(adverb). nghiêm trọng

(noun). người bảo tồn

(noun). đám cháy lớn

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

(adjective). thảm họa

biodiversity

(noun). sự đa dạng sinh học

Ex: The mining project threatens one of the world’s richest areas of biodiversity.

avian

(adjective). thuộc loài chim

Ex: The drug is known to be effective in the treatment of avian flu.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

absolutely

(adverb). tuyệt đối

Ex: You're absolutely right.

absent

(adjective). vắng mặt

tuck

(verb). ấp ủ, giấu đi một chỗ

secretive

nest

(noun). tổ

(verb). đặt vào vị trí

echo

(verb). vang vọng, vọng lại

(verb). trải dài

(noun). động vật không xương sống

burrow

(noun). hang

(adjective). nhiều, dồi dào

(verb). áp đảo, lấn át

(verb). đông hơn

(adjective). bản địa, địa phương

Ex: The Aborigines are the native inhabitants of Australia.

early

(adjective). ban sơ, nguyên thủy

(adjective). thiết yếu, quan trọng

Ex: She had found out some information of vital importance.

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

store

(verb). lưu trữ, cất giữ

(noun). bụi cây

burn

(verb). đốt cháy

increase

(verb). làm tăng lên, tăng lên

soil

Ex: She dug the compost into the soil.

release

(verb). giải phóng

(noun). lá cây

species

(noun). giống loài

(noun). chuỗi thức ăn

Ex: Pesticides work their way up the food chain from plants, through insects and birds to humans.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

result

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: This book is the result of 25 years of research.

lead to

(verb). dẫn đến

Ex: Reducing speed limits should lead to fewer deaths on the roads.

sparse

(adjective). thưa thớt, rải rác

Ex: Vegetation becomes sparse higher up the mountains.

scatter

(verb). rải rác

Ex: Scatter the lawn with grass seed.

diversity

(noun). sự đa dạng

Ex: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.

distribution

(noun). sự phân bổ

Ex: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.

viable

(adjective). khả thi

Ex: There is no viable alternative.

vegetation

(noun). Thảm thực vật

Ex: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.

remain

(verb). vẫn, giữ như cũ

Ex: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.

plantation

(noun). Đồn điền

Ex: Hundreds of slaves used to work on the plantations.

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

convert

(verb). Chuyển đổi

Ex: The hotel is going to be converted into a nursing home.

coax

(verb). chăm sóc

Ex: Stem cells are coaxed to grow into a variety of cells to be injected into patients.

restore

(verb). phục hồi

Ex: The measures are intended to restore public confidence in the economy.

replant

(verb). trồng lại

Ex: He tells them that the olive tree has been broken at the branches, but that these branches could be replanted.

prohibitive

(adjective). quá cao giá

Ex: The price of property in the city is prohibitive.

expense

(noun). phí tổn, chi phí

Ex: The garden was transformed at great expense.

reach

(verb). đạt đến

Ex: His parents have not yet reached retirement age.

maturity

(noun). sự phát triển hoàn toàn, sự trưởng thành

Ex: The forest will take 100 years to reach maturity.

alive

(adjective). còn tồn tại

Ex: Money from charities is keeping the theatre alive.

(verb). cho là do, quy cho

(noun). Yếu tố

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

(verb). dự kiến

(noun). sự gợi lại

Ex: The bell is an elegant evocation of the past.

(noun). hiện tượng

(adjective). tiên tri, đoán trước

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

(adjective). chính

(verb). nhớ lại

(noun). Hoạt động giải trí

(adjective). đáng chú ý, đặc biệt

(noun). trình tự, nghi thức

sequence

(noun). Trình tự

stunned

(adjective). kinh ngạc

supreme

(adjective). lớn nhất, quan trọng nhất

suspension

(noun). tình trạng treo, sự đình chỉ

(verb). duy trì

Ex: She managed to sustain everyone's interest until the end of her speech.

universal

(adjective). Phổ cập khắp nơi

Ex: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.

vivid

(adjective). Sống động

aloud

(adverb). to lên

Ex: The teacher listened to the children reading aloud.

(verb). Phỏng đoán

currently

(adverb). tại thời điểm hiện tại

Ex: All the options are currently available.

doubtful

(adjective). đáng nghi

Ex: It's doubtful if this painting is a Picasso.

formal

(adjective). Có tính nghi thức, lịch sự, trang trọng

Ex: He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.

majority

(noun). phần đa số

Ex: The majority of people interviewed prefer TV to radio.

misunderstanding

(noun). hiểu nhầm

Ex: The meeting is a final chance to clear up any misunderstandings.

narrate

(verb). trần thuật

Ex: She entertained them by narrating her adventures in Africa.

rely

(verb). dựa trên, dựa vào

Ex: They had to rely entirely on volunteer workers.

statistically

(adverb). theo thống kê

Ex: The difference between the two samples was not statistically significant.

categorisation

(noun). sự phân loại, sự phân nhóm

Ex: No one has come up with a satisfactory categorisation scheme for odours.

respectively

(adverb). tương ứng, theo thứ tự lần lượt

(adjective). thuộc về sân khấu

Ex: The festival features visual art, theatrical performances and music at various Austin venues.

(noun). Khán giả

Ex: The museum is trying to attract a wider audience.

tragedy

(noun). thể loại bi kịch

Ex: Shakespeare's tragedies include "Hamlet", "King Lear", and "Othello".

(noun). mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.

fundamental

(adjective). Căn bản, cốt lõi

Ex: You have a fundamental right to privacy.

prime

(adjective). chủ yếu, căn bản

Ex: My prime concern is to protect my property.

thread

(noun). mạch truyện

Ex: As the film progresses, the threads of the plot slowly begin to unravel.

(noun). sự dệt, sự xâu chuỗi

(noun). Sự hỗ trợ

Ex: He can only walk with the assistance of crutches.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

(verb). Ghi nhận, ghi lại

Ex: Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.

(adjective). bằng lời nói

(noun). văn xuôi

Ex: I've always preferred reading prose to poetry.

(verb). kể lại

(adjective). chuyên, chuyên gia

Ex: She had an amazing memory and could recall verbatim quite complex conversations.

(noun). Sự giả tưởng

(noun). nhân vật

Ex: She looked magnificent in her wedding dress.

mighty

(adjective). hùng mạnh

Ex: In the 1600s, this family was among the mightiest in the kingdom.

protagonist

(noun). nhân vật chính

Ex: The main protagonist is a cruel, selfish man.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

archive

(noun). Kho lưu trữ

Ex: I've been studying village records in the local archive.

manifestation

(noun). sự biểu lộ, sự biểu thị

Ex: Some manifestation of your concern would have been appreciated.

parchment

(noun). giấy da

Ex: A framed parchment hung on the wall.

priestly

(adjective). thuộc thầy tế, thuộc thầy tu

Ex: The women are taking over priestly and clerical duties, such as chaplaincies.

trace

(verb). Lần theo

Ex: We finally traced him to an address in Chicago.

organic

(adjective). hữu cơ

Ex: The farm went fully organic in 1996.

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

myth

(noun). truyền thuyết

Ex: The story parallels the creation myth of the ancient Babylonians.

notch

(verb). lưu trữ, ghi lại

Ex: Her band notched another Grammy Award last night.

recitation

(noun). sự kể lại

Ex: We were entertained with songs and recitations.

successive

(adjective). liên tục

Ex: This was their fourth successive win.

tool

(noun). công cụ

Ex: Always select the right tool for the job.

adopt

(verb). Thông qua, lựa chọn

Ex: All three teams adopted different approaches to the problem.

mediterranean

(noun). Địa Trung Hải

Ex: The hotel boasts spectacular views of the Mediterranean.

aspiring

(adjective). tha thiết, mong mỏi

Ex: Aspiring musicians need hours of practice every day.

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

Ex: The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.

incomplete

(adjective). chưa đầy đủ, chưa hoàn thành

Ex: Spoken language contains many incomplete sentences.

slim

(adjective). ít ỏi

Ex: The party was returned to power with a slim majority.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

literary

(adjective). mang tính văn chương

Ex: Her internationally acclaimed novel has won several literary prizes.

capacity

(noun). khả năng

Ex: She has an enormous capacity for hard work.

engagement

(noun). sự tham gia

Ex: Her views are based on years of engagement with the problems of the inner city.

enlist

(verb). kêu gọi, tranh thủ cảm tình, sự cộng tác,...

Ex: They hoped to enlist the help of the public in solving the crime.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

particularly

(adverb). một cách cụ thể

Ex: Traffic is bad, particularly in the city centre.

potent

(adjective). có hiệu lực, có uy lực lớn

Ex: The Berlin Wall was a potent symbol of the Cold War.

purge

(verb). làm trong sạch, thanh lọc

Ex: Nothing could purge the guilt from her mind.

unfold

(verb). lộ ra, bày ra

Ex: The audience watched as the story unfolded before their eyes.

canonical

(adjective). hợp với quy tắc tiêu chuẩn, hợp với kinh điển

Ex: She pursues her task ambitiously, tirelessly, and scrupulously through the major texts of three canonical writers of early modern English literature.

landmark

(noun). cột mốc

Ex: The film is an important landmark in the history of the cinema.

measure

(verb). Đo lường

Ex: Blood pressure and heart rate should be measured before treatment.

status

(noun). cấp bậc, địa vị

Ex: In the teaching of literature, Shakespeare is given a special status.

dramatic

(adjective). kịch tính

Ex: There has been a dramatic rise in reported crime.

flaw

(noun). khuyết điểm

Ex: The argument is full of fundamental flaws.

intrinsically

(adverb). về bản chất, thực chất

Ex: There is nothing intrinsically wrong with the idea.

mortal

(noun). con người, người trần mắt thịt

Ex: Such things are not for mere mortals like ourselves.

prone

(adjective). Dễ bị phải

Ex: Working without a break makes you more prone to error.

sections.title: Passage 3: Living Dunes
sections.html:
weird

(adjective). kì lạ

Ex: I had a really weird dream last night.

vegetation

(noun). Thảm thực vật

Ex: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.

variable

(noun). Biến số

Ex: With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

stable

(adjective). ổn định, bền vững

Ex: The situation in the country has remained relatively stable for a few months now.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

relentlessly

(adverb). 1 cách không ngừng nghỉ

Ex: Summer there is relentlessly hot.

prominent

(adjective). nổi bật

Ex: The church tower was a prominent feature in the landscape.

overwhelm

(verb). áp đảo, lấn át

Ex: The wave broke through the wall and overwhelmed the town.

offspring

(noun). hậu duệ, con cái

Ex: The beast was believed to be the offspring of a panther.

migrate

(verb). Di cư

Ex: These animals migrate annually in search of food.

formation

(noun). Sự hình thành; Đội hình

Ex: This dispute led to the formation of a new breakaway group.

entire

(adjective). toàn bộ

Ex: You two are her favourite people in the entire world.

emit

(verb). phát ra

Ex: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.

displace

(verb). chiếm chỗ

Ex: Gradually factory workers have been displaced by machines.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

automate

(verb). tự động hóa

Ex: The entire manufacturing process has been automated.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

swallow

(verb). nuốt chửng

Ex: Large areas of countryside have been swallowed up by towns.

priority

(noun). sự ưu tiên

Ex: Education is a top priority.

primary

(adjective). chính

Ex: The primary aim of this course is to improve your spoken English.

potential

(adjective). Tiềm năng

Ex: We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.

devour

(verb). ngấu nghiến, tàn phá

Ex: Flames devoured the house.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

Ex: Remember that actions have consequences.

bury

(verb). chôn vùi

Ex: The house was buried under ten feet of snow.

measurement

(noun). sự đo lường

Ex: Accurate measurement is very important in science.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

crescent

(noun). hình lưỡi liềm

Ex: The moon was a slender crescent.

recognise

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: Most of us recognize the importance of diet.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

comprise

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The committee is comprised of representatives from both the public and private sectors.

merge

(verb). hợp nhất

Ex: His department will merge with mine.

loose

(adjective). Lỏng lẻo

Ex: One of the bricks feels slightly loose.

combination

(noun). Sự phối hợp

Ex: His treatment was a combination of surgery, radiation and drugs.

obstacle

(noun). Vật cản, chướng ngại vật

Ex: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

steep

(adjective). Dốc đứng

Ex: The path grew steeper as we climbed higher.

deposit

(verb). lắng

Ex: Sand was deposited which hardened into sandstone.

comparison

(noun). sự so sánh

Ex: The films are too different for a fair comparison.

collapse

(verb). sụp đổ

Ex: All opposition to the plan has collapsed.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

process

(noun). Quá trình

Ex: Repeat this process until the entire area is tiled.

spread

(verb). Dàn trải, lan toả

Ex: The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.

reform

(verb). cải cách

Ex: The law needs to be reformed.

outpace

(verb). nhanh hơn

Ex: He easily outpaced the other runners.

gradually

(adverb). dần dần

Ex: Over the next three weeks, the effect gradually returned.

gentle

(adjective). nhẹ

Ex: Cook over a gentle heat.

dynamic

(adjective). năng động

Ex: The business has managed to change and remain dynamic.

curiously

(adverb). một cách kì lạ

Ex: His clothes were curiously old-fashioned.

breed

(verb). gây ra, phát sinh ra

Ex: Nothing breeds success like success.

unnerving

(adjective). làm cho khó chịu, làm mất bình tĩnh

Ex: He has an unnerving habit of repeatedly glancing over my shoulder and out of the window.

unearthly

(adjective). bí hiểm, đáng sợ

Ex: Cats' cries have an unearthly quality.

superstition

(noun). sự mê tín

Ex: According to superstition, if you walk under a ladder it brings you bad luck.

spirit

(noun). tinh thần, linh hồn

Ex: The exhibition captures the spirit of the age.

otherworldliness

(noun). sự kết nối với thế giới tinh thần

Ex: His private manner and aloofness, coupled with his pre-eminent intellect, no doubt created an aura of other-worldliness around him.

localize

(verb). khoanh vùng

Ex: Electricians worked through the night to localize the faulty switches.

inability

(noun). sự không có khả năng

Ex: Some families go without medical treatment because of their inability to pay.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

Ex: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

demystify

(verb). làm sáng tỏ

Ex: What I need is a book that will demystify the workings of a car engine for me.

characteristic

(noun). Bản chất; Đặc trưng

Ex: All human languages share some common characteristics.

attribute

(verb). cho là do, quy cho

Ex: He attributes his success to hard work and a little luck.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

mechanism

(noun). Cơ chế hoạt động

Ex: These automatic cameras have a special focusing mechanism.

delve into

(verb). điều tra

Ex: We must delve back into history to find the reason.

theorise

(verb). đưa ra lý thuyết

Ex: The study theorises about the role of dreams in peoples' lives.

replicate

(verb). Sao chép, bắt chước

Ex: Researchers tried many times to replicate the original experiment.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

predict

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: Nobody could predict the outcome.

mysterious

(adjective). kỳ bí

Ex: Fate works in mysterious ways.

laboratory

(noun). Phòng thí nghiệm

Ex: The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.

haul

(verb). khiêng, lôi

Ex: The car was hauled out of the river.

discovery

(noun). khám phá

Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.

culprit

(noun). thủ phạm

Ex: The main culprit in the current crisis seems to be modern farming techniques.

unsure

(adjective). không chắc chắn

Ex: I was unsure how to reply to this question.

admit

(verb). thừa nhận

Ex: She admitted making a mistake.

wide

(adjective). rộng

Ex: The river gets quite wide here.

extend

(verb). kéo dài, mở rộng

Ex: Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car.

dune

(noun). cồn, đụn cát

Ex: It is generally agreed that the linear dunes in the Namib Sand Sea have extended from south to north.

momentum

(noun). đà

Ex: They began to lose momentum in the second half of the game.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

spiritual

(adjective). thuộc tinh thần, thuộc linh hồn

Ex: His music leads us on a spiritual journey.

purely

(adverb). đơn thuần

Ex: I saw the letter purely by chance.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

exact

(adjective). chính xác

Ex: It is an exact copy of the original document.

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

agency

(noun). cơ quan, sở, hãng, đại lý

Ex: She works for an advertising agency.

acoustic

(adjective). thuộc về thanh âm

Ex: The microphone converts acoustic waves to electrical signals for transmission.

commonly

(adverb). thường xuyên

Ex: This is one of the most commonly used methods.

basic

(adjective). cơ bản

Ex: Drums are basic to African music.

similar

(adjective). tương tự

Ex: The forest was similar but there was a trail I followed for a time

range

(noun). loại

Ex: There is a full range of activities for children.

alike

(adjective). giống nhau

Ex: Though John and Andrew look exactly alike, they act quite differently.

synchronise

(verb). xảy ra đồng thời

Ex: The sound track did not synchronise with the action.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

smooth

(adjective). nhẵn, trơn

Ex: The water was as smooth as glass.

remain

(verb). vẫn, giữ như cũ

Ex: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.

puzzling

(adjective). làm bối rối, làm hoang mang

Ex: It's a rather puzzling film.

function

(noun). Chức năng

Ex: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.
